title: A fast spectral particle method for the Landau equation
summary: We propose a fast deterministic particle method for the spatially homogeneous Landau equation. The method combines a particle representation of the solution with a Fourier approximation of the nonlinear collision flux. Nonuniform fast Fourier transforms are used to reconstruct the density from the particles and to evaluate the flux and density at the particle locations, while the convolutional structure of the flux enables its efficient computation by FFTs.
